The Mid-Season Invitational features the winners from 13 individual Riot leagues spring splits competing in the 5th annual tournament.

==Format==
*'''Play-In Group Stage''' - ''May 1st, 2nd & 5th in GG Stadium, {{Flag|vn}} Ho Chi Minh City''
** Two groups of four teams each, the Play-In '''Draw Show''' will take place on {{Countdown|date=April 23, 2019 - 19:00 {{Abbr/CST}}|rawdatetime=true}} (4:00{{abbr/PDT}})<ref name="draw show">{{cite web|url=https://nexus.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/2019/04/msi-2019-play-in-draw-show-guide/|title=MSI 2019 PLAY-IN DRAW SHOW GUIDE|date=2019-04-17|author=LOLESPORTS STAFF|publisher=LoL eSports}}</ref>
*** by {{flag|tw}} [[SwordArt]] & {{flag|vn}} [[SofM]]
** {{Abbr/Bo1}} Double round robin
** The <span class="bg-up">Winner</span> of each group advances to Play-In Knockout
** <span class="mw-customtoggle-Tiebreaker" style="border-bottom:1px dotted;">Each group contains two teams each from Pool 1 and Pool 2</span>
<div class="toccolours mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="mw-customcollapsible-Tiebreaker" style="margin-top:10px;width:50%;margin-left:45px">
* Pool 1: Turkey's TCL, Vietnam's VCS, Southeast Asia's LST, and the Commonwealth of Independent States’ LCL
* Pool 2: Japan's LJL, Latin America's LLA, Brazil's CBLOL, and Oceania's OPL
</div><!--
-->
*'''Play-In Knockout Stage''' - ''May 5th - 7th in GG Stadium, {{Flag|vn}} Ho Chi Minh City''
** Four teams, in the first round:
*** Winner of Group A against the team from LCS
*** Winner of Group B against the team from LMS
** {{Abbr/Bo5}} Double elimination format
** Three teams qualify for Group Stage
*'''Group Stage''' - ''May 10th - 14th in National Convention Center, {{Flag|vn}} Hanoi''
** Six teams: three from the Play-In Stage, three from LEC, LPL and LCK
** {{Abbr/Bo1}} Double Round-Robin
** Top 4 advanced to Knockout Stage
*'''Knockout Stage''' - ''May 17th - 19th in Heping Basketball Gymnasium, {{Flag|tw}} Taipei''
** Four teams
** {{Abbr/Bo5}} Single Elimination

==Prize Pool==
The initial prize pool of the tournament is $250,000 {{abbr/USD}}.
